contexts.text: Received something of conscience according to their religiosity.
Origin of the religiosity signified by Moab and Amnion. AC 2466.
The Gentiles have received something like conscience according to their religiosity. (Compare AC 1033:2.)
The Gentiles are (there) instructed... according to their religiosity... AC 2601. AC 2602. AC 2603.
The religiosity of adulterers is (as follows).
Uz, Buz, etc. = various religiosities and worships thence.
Various religiosities and worships (of the) third class of those who are saved. Signified.
Under Daughter, see this reference. AC 3024:4. AC 3024:6. AC 6729. AC 6729:end.
A religiosity from evil; (and) a religiosity from falsity. Signified.
They think that such things are contrary to their religiosity...
Worship idols, and yet live in charity according to their religiosity.
That (Jacob's) descendants were in their religiosity. Signified.
For such [a principle] of the Church as was with them is to be called a religiosity, being external worship without internal.
The religiosity... in itself had good... but as to those who were in it, it had nothing of good. Explained.
Those in such a state cannot be in good when in their religiosity.
Consultation... with the good and truth of this religiosity. Signified.
Accession to their religiosity, Signified, Explained. AC 4464.
That nation placed religiosity in representatives alone.
A sign that they were of their religiosity. Signified.
(A longing) towards the religiosity of that Church. Signified.
This (representative of a Church) is also called a religiosity.
The religiosity with the nation from... Judah. Signified. AC 4905.
With the Jewish nation there was not a Church, but only the external of the Church separated from its internal: this can only be called a religiosity.
What is submitted from the religiosity. Signified, Explained.
He who has not acquired truths... from his religiosity, as in the case of the Gentiles, and applied them to life, is not in good...
The ministries of that religiosity which is from falsity. Signified.
The truth of the Church near the religiosity there. Signified.
Consent from that religiosity. Signified.
That she should insinuate into him good suitable to the religiosity. Signified.
Those outside the Church who live in good according to their religiosity. Signified.
Moses and Aaron (here) represent the religiosity of that nation...
There are... two religiosities which are from Own intelligence... This religiosity is called Babel ... The other religiosity is...
A religiosity which is from proprium. Signified.
The gentiles at this day who know (spiritual things) have it from the religiosity which they have derived from Ancient times...

Those of them who from their religiosity acknowledge a Divine over all things; and from their religiosity perform offices of charity to the neighbour; in the other life, when instructed, receive the truths of faith, and are saved.
Those who have complete faith in their religiosity (are not to blame)...
The forest = the religiosity.
Conscience is formed with man from the religiosity in which he is...
Had lived in a kind of image of faith and charity according to their religiosity... and could not close the internal man.
Such is the lot of all who have lived in good according to their religiosity.
From that Church many religiosities were translated to the surrounding nations, and among them incensings.
That they should not adhere to any religiosity in which was evil. Signified, Explained.
That the evil of that religiosity and derivative worship was to be rejected. Signified, Explained.
Thus conjunction with the evil of any religiosity. Signified, Explained.
For to live according to the religiosity is to live interiorly...
Had lived in mutual charity according to their religiosity... are accepted...
Had lived a spiritual moral life according to their religiosity.
For everyone after death retains his religiosity...
Whence its holiness, except from the religiosity?
Various religiosities (are signified) by the nations around (Israel); concordant religiosities, by the good nations; and discordant religiosities, by the evil nations.
There are two evil religiosities, into which every Church... degenerates. Explained. DFaith 55.
For every evil religiosity blinds the eyes.
Are in a strong persuasion concerning the religiosity in which they are; especially in that religiosity which involves that they are to be worshipped...
That he might represent the Lord's Kingdom, that is, the Church with all the religiosities in the world.
A wife = the Church; and a concubine a religiosity.
The... religiosities of many nations (furnish arguments against the Divine Providence). Explained. DP 254, Explained.
When he regards the Mohammedan religiosity... Explained.
Although the religiosity concerning faith alone has been received...
They could not have been separated from the Catholic religiosity.
Dagon represented that religiosity.
Those who had cleansed their religiosities from the evils of falsity. Signified, Explained.
It is not called the Roman Catholic Church, but the Roman Catholic religiosity; because they do not approach the Lord, nor read the Word, and because they invoke the dead...
(The Jews) have adhered firmly to their religiosity.
No longer a Church, but a religiosity which counterfeits a Church.
Their religiosity. Signified, Explained.
Convert the Church into a religiosity.
As a Church in which there is no longer any good and truth is not a Church, it is called a religiosity. AE 1038. AE 1056. AE 1088.
This religiosity will still last in the world, because the love of commanding is implanted in everyone...
Four kinds of men from this religiosity. Signified.
Illustration by these religiosities...
Man's state after death from every religiosity. Explained.
Such as a man is as to his religiosity (here), such is he as to his religiosity after death.
